        executor = submitit.AutoExecutor(cluster=self._EXECUTOR, **init_params)

        # specify resources/parameters

        params = {

        }

                    idx,
                    f"job_id_for_{idx}",
                    Singleton.get_state(),
                )
            )

        jobs = executor.map_array(self, *zip(*job_params))
        return [j.results()[0] for j in jobs]
